sourceAuthority: CDC/NCHS NHANES public-use DEMO_J plus public-use Linked Mortality File; Human Infra aggregate-only domain metadata boundary.

sourceFindings.observedFact: CDC/NCHS NHANES variance guidance requires domain/subpopulation analysis to retain the full eligible design information and use a subpopulation indicator rather than dropping records before complex survey procedures.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: A Human Infra domain diagnostic may register domain axes and coverage metadata, but public weighted output remains blocked until a design-object domain mechanism and disclosure review are complete.

sourceFindings.observedFact: R survey subset.survey.design restricts a survey design to a subpopulation while retaining original design information about clusters and strata.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The future estimator must use a post-design domain mechanism; this diagnostic does not run or publish a design-based estimator.

sourceFindings.observedFact: The aggregate pilot already defines sex × ageBand grouping and covers 8 public aggregate domain combinations without persisting raw rows or individual rows.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The current diagnostic can verify domain metadata coverage and no-row-persistence boundaries while still avoiding public record counts, weighted rates, intervals or individual outputs.

readinessGates.evidence: Aggregate pilot validation passes and preserves aggregate-only, no-row-persistence boundaries.
Weighted-estimator readiness validation passes and still blocks weighted domain output.
The diagnostic binds sex and ageBand as the public aggregate domain axes.
The upstream aggregate pilot covers all 2 × 4 expected sex × ageBand domain combinations.
The diagnostic repeats no raw rows, no individual rows and no domain indicator rows.
The diagnostic does not repeat public record counts, death counts, weighted sums, rates, intervals or estimator output.
Domain degrees-of-freedom, lonely PSU, empty-domain and sparse-domain diagnostics remain absent.
No public weighted cells, rates, intervals or subgroup summaries have passed disclosure review.
No repository artifact computes or stores public NHANES weighted domain rates or design-based intervals.

allowedUses: domain indicator metadata diagnostic gate audit
proof that public aggregate domain coverage can be checked without row persistence
